coupling: The setter extraction widens the parser-owned reparse-deferral flag from XML_Bool to unsigned int while continuing to store only XML_TRUE or XML_FALSE. The later properties API copies sizeof that field into the caller-owned XML_Bool output. With the original one-byte field the copy is safe, and the widened field alone has no out-of-bounds access; together they write four bytes into a one-byte public API output. Repair requires checking the property getter against the storage declaration and the XML_Bool pointer contract across the two commits.
